Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The assay uses a specialized isobaric labeling strategy (iqPIR) specifically for cross-linking (XL-MS). While not a standard TMT/iTRAQ, it functions as an isobaric labeling approach for quantification in MS2. The 'mod_tpp' (Tandem Proteomics/Cross-linking) modifier is the closest fit for XL-MS workflows.

cell_lines: HeLa cells were grown in tissue culture
scope: The quantitative performance of the 6-plex iqPIR strategy is evaluated using defined mixtures of purified proteins as well as a more complex multiplexed sample of six HeLa biological replicates.
HeLa cells from six different confluent 150 mm culture dishes were crosslinked individually with each of the six isobaric iqPIR crosslinkers
The crosslinked cells were pelleted by centrifugation at 300 x g for 3 min and washed 3 times with PBS 1x. This was followed by LC-MS analysis

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The experiment analyzed two distinct types of material: 1) mixtures of purified standard proteins (ADH1, Albumin, Cytochrome C, Hemoglobin, Myoglobin) and 2) cross-linked HeLa cell pellets. Since the HeLa samples were processed as whole cells (cross-linked in situ and pelleted) without sub-fractionation or affinity purification of a specific complex, 'whole cell lysate' is the most appropriate scope for the cellular component.
